hypothesis: Using 128 threads per block with items_per_block also set to 128 tests smaller CTAs while retaining one output target per active thread and the baseline interaction arithmetic. The grid-stride loop maps every output index to one thread sequence, masks tails with target < n, and avoids omissions or duplicates for positive grid dimensions even if valid launch geometry changes. No speedup is assumed.
notes: The prior two-targets-per-thread candidate was correct but slower than baseline; this proposal instead tests block size 128 with one output per active thread. The controller must perform the correctness checks and official timing; no result is claimed for this candidate.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 128 to test smaller CTAs while keeping one output per thread for the configured launch.
Added a 64-bit grid-stride target loop with an n-bound tail condition; left the interaction loads, arithmetic, and per-target update unchanged.
